title: Find social media profiles by username
description: Type one username, or several, and get every public profile that uses it across 950+ sites, ranked by how sure we are. Adult and dating sites are never checked. Only the username is needed; everything else narrows the search.

username.title: Username
username.description: The handle to look up, for example elonmusk. You can paste @elonmusk or a profile link such as twitter.com/elonmusk, we take the handle out of it. Several at once: separate them with commas. If you paste an email address, we search the part before the @ and point you to the email tool.

usernames.title: More usernames (bulk)
usernames.description: One handle per line for bulk checks, up to 25 per run. Each username is scanned on its own, so 10 usernames take about 10 times as long as one.

top.title: How many sites to check
top.description: The most popular N sites from the list of 951 (adult and dating sites excluded). 100 sites take about 30 to 40 seconds per username, 300 about 2 minutes, all of them about 7 minutes.
top.sectionDescription: Leave these empty to check the most popular sites. Set one or more to narrow the search; filters combine.

websites.title: Only these sites
websites.description: Check only the sites you name, by domain: github.com, reddit.com, instagram.com. A partial name like github also works. Any of the 951 sites in the list is accepted; the run tells you if a name is not on it. When set, 'How many sites to check' is ignored.

siteType.title: Only this category
siteType.description: Restrict the search to one kind of site. The counts show how many sites are in each category. Adult and dating sites are never checked. Combine with 'How many sites to check' to take the most popular ones in that category.

countries.title: Only sites from these countries
countries.description: Where the site is based, not where the person lives. Most sites in the list are American or Indian; pick a country only when you know the person uses local platforms.

filter.title: Which matches to keep
filter.description: How sure a match must be before it is reported. Confident matches are the cleanest. Include possible matches when the handle is rare and you want every lead; expect a few wrong ones.
filter.sectionDescription: What each row should carry. Every found profile is one row, plus one summary row per run.

metadata.title: Add page details (title, description, image, language)
metadata.description: Reads each found profile page for its title, description, image and language when the site exposes them. On by default; turn off for the fastest possible run.

extract.title: Pull out emails, links and other patterns
extract.description: Scans each found profile page for email addresses, links and similar patterns and adds them to the row. Slower, and most sites show none without login.

timeout.title: Time limit (seconds)
timeout.description: The whole run stops after this many seconds. Usernames that could not start in time are listed in the summary instead of failing the run. A username on 100 sites needs about 40 seconds; on all 999 about 7 minutes.
